Pointed arch peak at x50 y4%, inner arch opening joins verticals around x6/94 y30%; bottom interior y95%. Orthographic front-on, symmetrical architecture, no perspective. Do not draw a checkerboard. No words, no labels, logo, UI, collage or sheet. One complete frame only, no characters.
